title: A URI is a compact sequence of characters that identifies an abstract or physical resource
summary: A URI is a compact sequence of characters that identifies an abstract or physical resource.
body: RFC 3986 defines a Uniform Resource Identifier as a compact sequence of characters that identifies an abstract or physical resource, and it defines the generic syntax and a process for resolving references. The source says: "Abstract A Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) is a compact sequence of characters that identifies an abstract or physical resource." Identification is not retrieval. The RFC is about the identifier. What a server returns when asked for a URI is a further protocol.

sources.title: RFC 3986: Uniform Resource Identifier (URI): Generic Syntax
